name: Vaani
summary: No-code platform to build, deploy and improve voice AI phone agents with memory and call screening.
description: Vaani lets teams describe a phone agent in plain language (Teacher AI builds the prompt, voice and tools), connect a knowledge base and go live on a real number. Features include cross-call memory, call screening handling, warm/live transfers and structured data after each call. Pay-as-you-go via prepaid wallet with a ₹1/min platform fee plus model and telephony costs; Enterprise is custom.
